limitations: Original enclosure and USB metal CAD retained with a rigid transform. The drawing confirms 121.27 mm overall including the lower power key; 120 mm describes the shell.

Screen window follows the 59.72 × 105.02 mm drawing; a 58.7475 × 104.44 mm active plane preserves 540:960 pixels and fits the photo border. Exact optical active area and layer depths are not independently measured.
Display framebuffer and user-button input use the existing independent paperdiy runtime; model review does not extend firmware or hardware validation.
Manufacturer photos retain their own rights. Shell/metal optical materials are visual approximations, not measured reflectance.

PCB is reconstructed from the official Assembly Kit component/reverse photos and dimension drawing. Outline, black finish, two bores and visible layout have evidence; hidden layer stack and exact package heights are not board CAD. UNKNOWN on the inner face identifies that remaining scope.

Antenna module, card socket, FPC connectors and observed SMT packages are independent meshes. Lettering and reverse-face traces use unmodified official image UVs; metallic component highlights are rendered with PBR materials. Photo brightness and color are not calibrated.

Complete Kit and Assembly Kit share the official schematic; assembly photo landmarks are registered to the native Complete Kit enclosure bore, keys and USB. This establishes visual assembly fit, not electrical manufacturing equivalence or a physical hardware test.
